title: Konu cümlesi ve destekleyici cümleler
explain_tr: İyi bir İngilizce paragraf genelde **4–6 cümledir** ve tek bir fikri anlatır. Yapı: **1) Konu cümlesi** (ana fikir) → **2–3) Destekleyici cümleler** (sebep, açıklama) → **4) Örnek** → **5) Sonuç cümlesi**.

**Konu cümlesi** paragrafın ilk cümlesidir ve okuyucuya ne anlatacağını söyler. Çok genel (*Technology is a thing.*) ya da çok dar (*I bought a phone on Monday.*) olmamalı: *Smartphones have changed the way people learn languages.* ✓

**Destekleyici cümleler** konu cümlesini açıklar. Her biri **tam cümle** olmalı: özne + çekimli fiil. *Because it is cheap.* tek başına cümle değildir ✗ (fragment); bir ana cümleye bağla: *Many people use apps **because they are cheap**.*
**Örnek** için: *For example, … / For instance, … / such as …*. **Sonuç** için: *In short, … / Overall, … / That is why …*.
Türkçede uzun, virgüllerle bağlı tek cümle doğal olabilir; İngilizcede bu **run-on sentence** sayılır. Her fikir için ayrı cümle kur ve noktayı kullan.
explain_en: A paragraph = topic sentence + supporting sentences + example + concluding sentence. Each sentence must be complete (subject + finite verb). Avoid fragments and run-on sentences.
table: Learning English online has many advantages.
First, it is **flexible**, so you can study at any time.
It is also usually **cheaper** than a private course.
**For example**, I practise with an app on the bus every morning.
**Overall**, online learning is a smart choice for busy people.

pairs.right: Many students choose online lessons because they are cheap.

pairs.wrong: My hometown is beautiful, it has mountains, the food is great, people are friendly, I miss it.
pairs.right: My hometown is beautiful. It has high mountains and the food is great. The people are also very friendly. That is why I miss it.
pairs.note_tr: Run-on: virgüllerle bağlanmış cümleleri ayır ve bağlaç ekle.

pairs.right: For example, my brother learned English by watching films.

pairs.wrong: Sport. It is good for health.
pairs.right: Doing sport regularly is good for your health.
pairs.note_tr: Konu cümlesi tam ve açık olmalı.

exercises.prompt: Which is the best topic sentence for a paragraph about the benefits of reading?
options: Reading regularly has several important benefits.
answer: Reading regularly has several important benefits.
exercises.explain_tr: Ana fikri söyler; ne çok geniş ne çok dar.

exercises.prompt: Which is NOT a complete sentence?
answer: Because the bus was late.
For instance,

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is the best conclusion?
options: Overall, cycling to work is healthy, cheap and good for the environment.
answer: Overall, cycling to work is healthy, cheap and good for the environment.

exercises.prompt: Many people prefer living in small towns. ___ example, life there is usually quieter and cheaper.
answer: For

exercises.prompt: Working from home saves time. ___ short, it makes life easier for many employees.
answer: In

exercises.prompt: My city has many parks ___ as Kuğulu Park and Gençlik Park.
answer: such

exercises.prompt: Because the rent too high. I want to move.
answer: I want to move because the rent is too high.
Because the rent is too high, I want to move.
exercises.explain_tr: İki sorun: fragment (Because… tek başına cümle değil) ve düşen **is**.

exercises.prompt: I enjoy cooking. Such as last week I made manti for ten people.
answer: I enjoy cooking. For example, last week I made manti for ten people.
I enjoy cooking. For instance, last week I made manti for ten people.
exercises.explain_tr: Cümle başında örnek vermek için **For example, / For instance,** kullanılır; *such as* sadece isimden önce gelir (*dishes such as manti*).

exercises.prompt: Learning a language takes time, you need to practise every day, you also need patience.
answer: Learning a language takes time. You need to practise every day, and you also need patience.
Learning a language takes time, so you need to practise every day. You also need patience.

exercises.explain_tr: Run-on: üç tam cümle sadece virgülle bağlanamaz → **so / and** ekle (ya da nokta koy).
exercises.hint: Virgülle bağlanmış cümleleri bağlaçla (and / so) düzelt.

exercises.prompt:
Bu iki fikri tek bir konu cümlesine çevir:
Public transport. It is useful in big cities.
answer: Public transport is very useful in big cities.
Public transport is useful in big cities.
exercises.explain_tr: Tam bir konu cümlesi: özne + is + sıfat.

exercises.prompt:
Fragment'i düzelterek birleştir:
I like summer. Because I can swim in the sea.
answer: I like summer because I can swim in the sea.
exercises.explain_tr: Because yan cümlesini ana cümleye bağla.

exercises.prompt:
"Overall" ile bir sonuç cümlesi yaz (paragraf: sabah sporu enerjik ve sağlıklı tutar):
morning exercise / good start to the day
answer: Overall, morning exercise is a good start to the day.
Overall, morning exercise gives you a good start to the day.
